subtitle: Out Manila · Cebu Pacific
overview: A classic Kansai tour of Osaka, Kyoto and Nara with a private coach and English-speaking guide. Walk Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka, visit Kiyomizu Temple and Fushimi Inari Shrine, try a matcha experience, then meet the deer at Todaiji. A free day in Osaka leaves room for an optional Universal Studios Japan trip. Fly Manila – Osaka with Cebu Pacific; stay in 3–4-star hotels.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 14–18 2027 to Jan 26–30 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Ninenzaka: A preserved old slope street in Kyoto lined with traditional wooden shops on the way to Kiyomizu Temple.
placeDesc.Sannenzaka: A historic stone-paved lane in Kyoto, linked to Ninenzaka on the walk to Kiyomizu Temple.
placeDesc.Kiyomizu Temple: A famous Kyoto Buddhist temple with a large wooden stage overlooking the city.
placeDesc.Fushimi Inari Shrine: A Kyoto Shinto shrine known for thousands of red torii gates up the mountain.
placeDesc.Todaiji Temple: A major Buddhist temple in Nara holding a giant bronze Buddha; the tour makes a photo stop.
placeDesc.Nara Deer Park: A large park in Nara where tame deer roam freely among temples.
placeDesc.Osaka Castle: A landmark castle in Osaka surrounded by moats and parkland; the tour makes a photo stop.
placeDesc.Shinsaibashi: A covered shopping arcade in central Osaka for free shopping time.
placeDesc.Dotonbori: Osaka's lively canal-side entertainment and street food district.
placeDesc.Rinku Premium Outlets: An outlet shopping mall near Kansai Airport, visited on the last day before departure.
placeDesc.Universal Studios Japan: Optional free-day tour to the theme park in Osaka, with one-day pass and transfer.
